description.narrative: The Humanitarian Logistics Capability investment facilitates the timely and effective delivery of Australian Government humanitarian assistance through the provision of appropriate and high-quality humanitarian supply chain logistics support. This investment is a flexible, responsive mechanism that provides partner governments and humanitarian partners with timely, appropriate, and complementary humanitarian supplies and logistics to prepare for and respond to crises. The end-of-investment outcomes are: 1. Australia provides partner governments and humanitarian partners with timely, appropriate and complementary humanitarian supplies and logistics services to prepare for and respond to crises. 2. Effective logistics capabilities are provided to the Australian government for humanitarian and urgent health and consular purposes.? This investment works with other Australian humanitarian programs, including deployable capabilities and NGO partnerships.
